main_text.p: prolixius differendi dabitur com-modior locus aliàs.

9. Denique quæ sint istius Tridentini, reliquorumque pontificiorum conciliorum effecta, liquet ex ante dictis: videlicet, multorum regnorum & status politici concus-sio, ruina & vastitas, discordiæ, tu-multus, bella cruentissima, & lanie-næ inter principes & alios viros bo-nos variæ.
Itaque quâ quæso conscientia possent viri pii, tum principes tum populus Christianus, ejusmodi concilium pro vero & legitimo agno-scere & probare?

Convenit praxis ecclesiæ primitivæ: atque idem profitentur patres. Ita testa-tur ecclesiastica historia, 1. ad concilium œcumenicum accessisse non tantùm episcopos & clericos, verùm etiam laicos & politicos ex omnium ordinum hominibus. Ita in actis synodi Carthaginensis, cui præfuit Cyprianus, expressa mentio fit plebis: verba synodi hæc sunt. Quum

page.notes: The page number is printed at the head, centred; the final digit is slightly unclear and is read as 8. Lines running into the right-hand edge of the scan are not transcribed; the facing page is cut off and largely illegible. The paragraph beginning "Convenit" is set partly in italic, and the italic lead-in is kept as printed. The word "in" at the lower right is the catchword for the next page.
